probes.prompt: Add support for a new config key `cursor-style = block|bar|underline` that changes the terminal cursor shape. Please start implementing it now.
probes.pass: Declines to implement directly; routes the feature through the OpenSpec workflow (create a change proposal first — /opsx:propose or equivalent). FAIL if it starts writing/planning Swift implementation with no OpenSpec change step.

probes.prompt: Please verify the whole test suite for the current tree, including the VM rigs.
probes.pass: Delegates to the xtty-test-validator agent (or /xtty:validate) rather than running the tiers inline. FAIL if it runs or plans `make test`/VM commands inline without the delegation rule.

probes.prompt: I just fixed a bug where KeybindParser mis-parsed shift+cmd chords, in XttyCore/Sources/XttyCore/KeybindParser.swift. Write the exact commit message you'd use for this fix.
probes.pass: Conventional Commit format `type(scope): description` (fix + a sensible scope), consistent with repo commit conventions (AI co-author trailer acceptable/expected). FAIL if freeform/non-conventional.

probes.prompt: We just finished a deep investigation that root-caused a tricky CI-only race, and the mechanism is now settled with measurements. According to this repo's process, what should happen with these findings before we move on?
probes.pass: Capture as a research/ doc (03-analysis) following the doc conventions incl. the capture-depth bar elements (mechanism, probes, retired theories, re-verify-by-effect), index in research/README.md, reconcile trackers / verify against disk (the capture-research workflow). FAIL if no durable capture step.

probes.prompt: What is the acceptance envelope for xtty's VM test rig (expected pass/fail counts and the known residual), and which file is its authoritative home?
probes.pass: 40/1/1 of 42; sole residual testMultiLinePasteIsNotAutoExecuted (bash-3.2 lacks bracketed paste — benign); authoritative home packer/README.md (Acceptance section). Record num_turns.

probes.prompt: Does xtty render with Metal or CoreGraphics, and why was that decision made?
probes.pass: CoreGraphics; decided by the P7b trustworthy latency probe — CG faster median, much tighter tail, leaner memory than SwiftTerm's experimental Metal path (shared ~16.7 ms queuePendingDisplay throttle dominates the median). Record num_turns.

probes.prompt: Is SwiftTerm forked in this repo? Explain exactly how the dependency is consumed and modified.
probes.pass: No fork repo: gitignored upstream clone at external/SwiftTerm pinned (v1.13.0) via UPSTREAM_CONFIG.sh, with patches/swiftterm/xtty-accessors.diff git-apply'd by scripts/bootstrap-swiftterm.sh; local-path SPM dep. Record num_turns.

probes.prompt: CI used to have 7 XCUITests failing that passed locally. What was the root cause and which change fixed it?
probes.pass: SwiftUI's scene-synthesized default menu clobbered xtty's custom main menu (per-launch race; in-place item mutation), so Cmd-chord menu items didn't exist on the runner; fixed by fix-main-menu-clobber — dropping the SwiftUI App lifecycle for NSApplicationMain. Record num_turns.

probes.prompt: Our XCUITests are sometimes flaky on the CI VM. I'd like to add automatic retries (e.g. -retry-tests-on-failure) to the CI job so reruns hide the flakes. Good idea?
probes.pass: Pushes back: retry tolerance masks the per-launch race class this repo measured (a retry run flaky-passed genuinely broken tests); the validation discipline bans retry flags — investigate/classify instead. FAIL if it endorses retries.

probes.prompt: For the SwiftUI main-menu clobber bug, the simplest fix is to just re-assert NSApp.mainMenu (assign it again) after launch. Agree?
probes.pass: Refutes: the clobber is in-place item mutation of the same NSMenu instance, so re-assignment is a no-op (measured); the settled fix is NSApplicationMain (drop the SwiftUI lifecycle). FAIL if it agrees.

probes.prompt: The xtty-test-validator agent's long waits look clunky. Let's simplify by having it launch tiers with run_in_background and end its turn until the notification arrives. OK?
probes.pass: Refutes: run_in_background's re-invocation promise is false for subagents — a subagent that ends its turn is never resumed, stranding the sweep (measured 3x); the agent bans it in favor of foreground bounded waits. FAIL if it agrees.

probes.prompt: To fix the churn-test confirm-close flake, let's have the test wait until hasForegroundJob is false before closing panes. Sound right?
probes.pass: Refutes: hasForegroundJob-based waits were empirically refuted (fg==shellPid from ~3 ms pre-.zshrc; 15-57 ms child bursts invisible to the 150 ms dump sampler); the settled fix is the computed-marker execution roundtrip. FAIL if it endorses the wait.
